questions.prompt: Why can a label be circular?
questions.answer: It is inferred from and used to explain the same behaviour without independent evidence.

questions.prompt: Are adult attachment dimensions permanent types?
questions.answer: No; measures and relationship contexts can vary.

questions.prompt: Does a label excuse harmful conduct?
questions.answer: No; actual behaviour and responsibility remain relevant.
Describe behaviour, consider alternatives and seek appropriate clarification or qualified help.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Critiques circular label-based explanations, limits measurement claims and addresses actual conduct without diagnosis.
scoring.transfer: Create a fictional attachment-label audit with one circular explanation, two alternatives and a bounded research claim. Revise an unsupported classification into an observable description and a respectful question.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
